info.title: FieldLoop internal mock historian
info.description: Synthetic read-only simulator endpoint from architecture section 4.2. Not a web-api/BFF endpoint. Run behind Cloud Run invoker IAM in dev/demo; local reads need no credentials. No real historian connector, and no write operation. Simulated observations reach the platform only as signal.v1 messages that the Scenario player publishes in process.

servers.description: Local simulator as the repository README starts it. Deployed environments call the private simulator-{env} Cloud Run service with a Google OIDC ID token.

get.description: Return deterministic synthetic samples on a 60 second UTC clock grid for one Demo A tag between from and to (inclusive, at most 24 hours). The series is a pure function of tag, timestamp and the simulator seed, plus any Scenario overrides; the clock is the caller's window, never wall time.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Served tags: DL-01.pressure.line, DL-01.flow.line and DL-01.rectifier.output. Any other tag is 404.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Timezone-aware RFC 3339 window end; must be after from and at most 24 hours later.

400.description: Missing or invalid window; code validation_failed, input values are not echoed.

405.description: Only GET is served, so every other method is refused; code method_not_allowed, and Allow names the methods the path serves. No state mutation.

serviceIdentity.description: Verified by Cloud Run invoker IAM, not proxy headers. The handler does not implement browser auth or independently validate IAM.
